headline: Europe Enters Winter With Lowest Gas Reserves Since 2013, Says IEA
summary: The International Energy Agency warned that Europe is entering the winter heating season with its lowest natural gas reserves level since 2013, potentially extending market price pressures into 2027.
why: Energy inventory levels dictate regional heating and industrial power costs across Europe, directly influencing international liquefied natural gas (LNG) pricing and utility sector profitability.

impacts.name: European Utilities
impacts.why: Low gas reserves heighten the likelihood of elevated fuel input costs for European energy providers.
